Ivy N.: Hey finance - quick one from the field. Rented an EV for client visits yesterday. At a ChargePoint station the corp card tap failed so I paid charging session on my personal card via the app: $28.70 (screenshot attached). Later the corp card shows a separate "EV-ROAM FEE" $3.00 from a roaming aggregator. How should I submit so the company reimburses the charge I paid and we reconcile the roaming fee?
expense-bot: For charging sessions paid personally because corp card couldn't be used, submit a personal reimbursement with the charging app receipt + card line screenshot. For roaming/aggregator fees on the corporate card, include both transactions in the notes so finance can net/reconcile. Example:
```/expenses submit
line1: 28.70 USD -> business - EV charging (attach chargepoint_receipt.png, personal_card_tx.png)
notes: "Corp card tap failed at station ID CP-4217; roaming fee $3.00 posted to corp card (see attached corp statement)."```
Ivy N.: Uploads: chargepoint_receipt.png -> https://redwood-files/receipts/ev_charge_1924000001.png ; personal_card_tx.png -> https://redwood-files/receipts/personal_card_1924000001.png ; corp_card_line.png -> https://redwood-files/receipts/corp_card_1924000001.png
Jared (Finance): Thanks Ivy. Two asks: 1) please include the station ID and timestamp from the ChargePoint receipt (we need to match to roaming remittance). 2) if possible, forward the ChargePoint session ID or transaction reference so we can request remittance from the aggregator. We'll reimburse the $28.70 to you and investigate/offset the $3.00 aggregator fee on the corp ledger if it corresponds to the same session.
Ivy N.: Station ID CP-4217, session ID CPSESSION-9082, charged at 2026-04-11 09:22 local. App shows payment method: VISA **** 1234 (my personal). Attached screenshot has the session id.
Marta (Manager): Approving manager sign-off for the reimbursement. Approve for business purpose: client visits in Palo Alto.
Jared (Finance): Manager approval noted. Policy note: roaming aggregator fees under $5 that are part of the same EV session are usually absorbed by finance while we reconcile with the vendor. If the aggregator posts a duplicate or service fee not tied to that session, we'll open a vendor inquiry. Please submit the /expenses entry for $28.70 and tag me. Also include the corp-card screenshot showing the $3.00 line so we can map it.
Ivy N.: Submitted per template and tagged @Jared. Thanks.
corp-card-bot: Card transaction detected: roaming-fee matched to cardline. Status: pending-investigation -> /expenses view 1924000001
Jared (Finance): Got it - I'll process your reimbursement for $28.70 on the next payroll run. For the $3.00 roaming fee, I'm opening a vendor ticket with the aggregator (ref: AG-4421) to request remittance details. If they confirm it's part of the same session we'll absorb it; if not we'll follow up with the rental vendor. Expect update in 3-4 business days.
Ivy N.: Appreciate it - also FYI my bank posted $28.92 (2% foreign conversion fee) as USD since app billed in CAD. Do you need the bank conversion screenshot?
Jared (Finance): Please attach the personal card bank line showing $28.92 and we'll reimburse the posted USD amount you actually paid. For FX rounding under $1 we typically absorb differences, but we reimburse the exact posted amount.
Ivy N.: Uploaded bank_line.png -> https://redwood-files/receipts/bankline_1924000001.png. Thanks for handling.
Jared (Finance): Reimbursement scheduled for next payroll: $28.92 USD (matches personal posting). Roaming fee inquiry opened. Closing this thread when vendor confirms or ledger updated. :white_check_mark:
